Usage: protonvpn config set netshield [OPTIONS] {off|malware-only|malware-ads-
                                      trackers}

  Configure NetShield ad-blocking and malware protection.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

  Values:
    off                    NetShield disabled
    malware-only           Block malware domains
    malware-ads-trackers   Block malware, ads, and trackers (recommended)
  
  Examples:
    protonvpn config set netshield off
    protonvpn config set netshield malware-only
    protonvpn config set netshield malware-ads-trackers
  
  Current Setting:
    Run 'protonvpn config list' to see current value.
  
  How It Works:
    NetShield blocks malicious and advertising domains at the DNS level,
    preventing malware downloads and removing ads before they load.
